en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Abu Khadeeja who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Even if the servant is inside a rock, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Bring him his sustenance, so better yourselves in the seeking’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Hashim from abu Khadijah who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Even if a servant lives in a hole, Allah has his sustenance for him. Thus you must seek your sustenance meticulously.’”
